author: MetaBallStudios
description:
Discover the sizes of some iconic fictional buildings from a unique perspective. This video takes you on a tour, passing close to buildings of all sizes and even entering some of them.

NOTES: Many examples were not selected due to imprecise information (or the impossibility of estimating it), or because they lack a clear structure for accurate representation (examples from novels). Some cases deviate from the general concept being sought; for example, primarily spatial structures, as well as cities, are excluded.
There may be inaccuracies or inconsistencies in some measurements as they are simple estimates; we will try to take the most reasonable measurement.

~ - Approximate
± - Error range
*UM - Unreliable Measure
White texts have sources
Yellow texts are MBS estimates
